picks.editorial_note: An $874M federal commitment across seven companies to rebuild domestic semiconductor R&D capacity directly underwrites the compute supply chain that AI research depends on — a policy move with outsized downstream impact on the field.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's neuroprosthetic brain-computer interface let an ALS patient speak again in his own voice — a landmark demonstration of AI restoring lost human capability, not just augmenting it.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: A $21.5M NSF AI Institute anchored at Penn and Delaware signals sustained federal investment in human-AI collaboration for healthcare, one of the highest-stakes application domains for the technology.
picks.title: Penn partners in new National Science Foundation AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into the DOE's Genesis Mission exemplifies a new model of tri-sector coordination — government, industry, and academia jointly wielding AI and supercomputing on national scientific priorities.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's role in the CuspAI-led AI Materials Foundry links a top research university into a global industrial network aimed at collapsing materials-discovery timelines with AI-driven design and robotics.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry

picks.editorial_note: University of Florida's six-year tally — $511M in AI research awards and a top-tier HiPerGator supercomputer — illustrates the scale of institutional bet-making now underway in university AI infrastructure.
picks.title: AI year in review

picks.editorial_note: HKU's ClairS algorithm brings high-accuracy cancer mutation detection to long-read sequencing across multiple cancer types, a concrete clinical-genomics advance with direct diagnostic value.
picks.title: HKU School of Computing and Data Science research team develops ClairS, achieving high-accuracy cancer mutation detection across multiple cancer types - All News - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: William & Mary's Genesis Mission award to build AI foundation models for particle physics, in partnership with Jefferson Lab and Brookhaven, shows AI methods moving into fundamental physics infrastructure at national-lab scale.
picks.title: William & Mary receives DOE Genesis Mission award to advance AI-powered particle physics

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework, which lets generalist and specialist AI models collaborate on disease diagnosis, points toward more accurate and efficient clinical AI architectures.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Novel AI Framework Enabling Efficient Collaboration between Generalist and Specialist Models for Disease Diagnosis
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: UAB's EVOSYNTH framework combines evolutionary optimization with synthesis-aware design to generate multi-target drug candidates for complex diseases like cancer, a meaningful step for AI-driven drug discovery.
picks.title: Researchers create a framework that could change the discovery of complex disease drug candidates
